scope: Tuning-set-only Hybrid+RRF+Reranker configuration experiment; not production integration and not W7-T3 heldout evaluation.

selection_rule_declared_before_results.candidate_count: Require Candidate Recall@N, final Recall@K, and final MRR@K to be no lower than the baseline; maximize those quality metrics in that order, then prefer the smaller candidate count on a complete tie.
selection_rule_declared_before_results.final_top_k: Require final_top_k >= 2 for the known multi-relevant use case and require final Recall@K and MRR@K to be no lower than the K=3 baseline; maximize quality, then prefer the smaller K on a tie.
selection_rule_declared_before_results.excluded_factors: Do not select by one query or latency. Heldout and unanswerable queries are not evaluated during W7-T2 tuning.

strict_chunk_diagnostic.limitation: Diagnostic only: W7-T2 tuning contains two queries with strict chunk labels; q027 remains held out.

latency_sanity_ms.selection_usage: not_used; formal latency trade-off is W7-T4

selection_rationale.candidate_count: Applied the predeclared no-regression rule and selected N=3.
selection_rationale.final_top_k: Applied the predeclared multi-relevant/no-regression rule and selected K=2.
selection_rationale.claim_boundary: This is a tuning-set recommendation for W7-T3. Heldout quality has not been measured and superiority is not established.

latency_policy: Recorded only as a sanity signal; not used for selection and not a substitute for the W7-T4 latency trade-off experiment.
known_limitations: Primary labels are document-level and can hide chunk-ranking errors.
Only q025 and q026 provide strict chunk diagnostics in tuning; q027 is held out.
The corpus has only four documents and twelve chunks, so metrics may saturate.
No production Search/Chat/RAG default is changed by this experiment.
